title: T-cell receptor specific protein language model for prediction and interpretation of epitope binding (ProtLM.TCR)
authors: Ahmed Essaghir; Nanda Kumar Sathiyamoorthy; Paul Smyth; Adrian Postelnicu; Stefan Ghiviriga; Alexandru Ghita; Anjana Singh; Shruti Kapil; Sanjay Phogat; Gurpreet Singh
one_liner_zh: 该文用TCR蛋白语言模型预测TCR-表位结合并做可解释性分析，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白互作和AI方法，但对象为折叠蛋白TCR而非无序蛋白/IDR，且未涉及相分离或互作机制建模，仅作预测应用，故给5分。
abstract: The cellular adaptive immune response relies on epitope recognition by T-cell receptors (TCRs). We used a language model for TCRs (ProtLM.TCR) to predict TCR-epitope binding. This model was pre-trained on a large set of TCR sequences (~62.10 6 ) before being fine-tuned to predict TCR-epitope bindings across multiple human leukocyte antigen (HLA) of class-I types. We then tested ProtLM.TCR on a balanced set of binders and non-binders for each epitope, avoiding model shortcuts like HLA categories. We compared pan-HLA versus HLA-specific models, and our results show that while computational prediction of novel TCR-epitope binding probability is feasible, more epitopes and diverse training datasets are required to achieve a better generalized performances in de novo epitope binding prediction tasks. We also show that ProtLM.TCR embeddings outperform BLOSUM scores and hand-crafted embeddings. Finally, we have used the LIME framework to examine the interpretability of these predictions.
abstract_zh: 细胞适应性免疫应答依赖于T细胞受体（TCRs）对表位的识别。我们利用一种针对TCR的语言模型（ProtLM.TCR）来预测TCR-表位结合。该模型在大量TCR序列（约62.10^6）上进行了预训练，随后针对多个I类人类白细胞抗原（HLA）类型进行了微调，以预测TCR-表位结合。接着，我们在每个表位的平衡结合子与非结合子集合上测试了ProtLM.TCR，避免了如HLA类别等模型捷径。我们比较了泛HLA与HLA特异性模型，结果显示，尽管计算预测新型TCR-表位结合概率是可行的，但需要更多的表位和多样化的训练数据集，以在从头表位结合预测任务中实现更好的泛化性能。我们还表明，ProtLM.TCR嵌入优于BLOSUM评分和手工设计的嵌入。最后，我们利用LIME框架检验了这些预测的可解释性。
